title: Three Years Old
simplified_paragraphs: 妈妈问儿子：“你今年几岁了？”
儿子回答：“我今年三岁了。”
妈妈又问：“那爸爸几岁了？”
妈妈很奇怪：“爸爸为什么只有三岁呢？”
“因为爸爸是在我出生那一天才变成爸爸的！”
traditional_paragraphs: 媽媽問兒子：“你今年幾歲了？”
兒子回答：“我今年三歲了。”
媽媽又問：“那爸爸幾歲了？”
媽媽很奇怪：“爸爸為什麼只有三歲呢？”
“因為爸爸是在我出生那一天才變成爸爸的！”
pinyin_paragraphs: mā ma wèn ér zi：“ nǐ jīn nián jǐ suì le？”
ér zi huí dá：“ wǒ jīn nián sān suì le。”
mā ma yòu wèn：“ nà bà ba jǐ suì le？”
ér zi shuō：“ bà ba yě sān suì。”
mā ma hěn qí guài：“ bà ba wèi shén me zhǐ yǒu sān suì ne？”
“ yīn wèi bà ba shì zài wǒ chū shēng nà yī tiān cái biàn chéng bà ba de！”
english_paragraphs: A mother asked her son, “How old are you this year?”
Her son answered, “I’m three years old.”
She asked, “Then how old is Dad?”
Her son said, “Dad is three, too.”
Puzzled, she asked, “Why is Dad only three?”
“Because he didn’t become a dad until the day I was born!”
english_full:
A mother asked her son, “How old are you this year?”

Her son answered, “I’m three years old.”

She asked, “Then how old is Dad?”

Her son said, “Dad is three, too.”

Puzzled, she asked, “Why is Dad only three?”

“Because he didn’t become a dad until the day I was born!”
